class.name: SnowCornice3D
class.brief_description: Draws the cornices a [SnowCover3D]'s world tier grew on lee crests, with collision.
class.description: The overhanging slabs the wind builds on lee crests. [SnowCover3D]'s world tier grows one per crest cell while the wind blows between the threshold for moving snow and twice it, fastest about 40% above it (Yu et al. 2023), from loose dry snow upwind, at field rates of about 1.6 cm an hour (Hancock et al. 2020); they waste back in thaws and in gales. This node draws those within [member radius] of the camera as a swept profile along each run of crest cells: a slab out from the crest top, as thick as it is long at its root and thinning to a sagging lip, its roots reaching down to the ground through the crest's snow. The tension crack behind each cornice shows as a crack in its roof with the slab tilting out about its root (Vogel et al. 2012), and a cornice that falls breaks into tumbling blocks (see [member SnowCover3D.cornice_failure_enabled]). It rebuilds as the camera moves and as the world tier updates. Under path tracing it is ordinary geometry.

method.name: get_debris_count
method.description: How many falling blocks of failed cornices there are.

method.name: get_segment_count
method.description: How many pieces of profile the last rebuild swept.

method.name: rebuild
method.description: Rebuilds the cornices around the camera now.
